messages:
marie-support: FYI customer NimblePay reports hourly usage missing for 2026-03-12 02:00-06:00 UTC in Console. They see a big gap in their usage graph and are getting billing alerts.
elaine-support: thanks marie — do we have a tenant id / org id?
marie-support: tenant nimblepay-prod, org_id=org_8nM4. They attached a screenshot + sample request ids.
raj-dataeng: pinging ingest team — any recent rollouts to the ETL or connector configs around that time?
carlos-sre: nothing infra-side scheduled, but there was an autoscaler throttle on stream-workers at 02:15 UTC for ~7m (k8s spike). Might have caused backpressure.
ingest-bot: consumer-group offsets: consumer_ingest_grp paused at partition 12 between 02:10-02:24 UTC due to fetch errors (timeout).
raj-dataeng: looking at pipeline logs now. I'm seeing repeated parquet write errors to s3://redwood-analytics/tenants/org_8nM4/2026/03/12/02/ - checksum mismatch on manifest write around 02:18.
marie-support: customer says they retried querying after 05:00 UTC and some hours showed up, but totals still low. They need repro steps to file for billing investigation.
raj-dataeng: likely scenario: consumer faced transient fetch timeouts -> some hourly segments were marked as partial -> downstream rollups skipped until backfill. We'll repro locally with the same offsets.
carlos-sre: I've redeployed stream-workers with bumped fetch timeout + enabled debug logging on the consumer; created an adhoc reprocess job ticket (#J-4281).
elaine-support: please paste repro steps for me to pass to NimblePay support team so they can see what's happening.
raj-dataeng: repro steps: 1) set consumer group to recorded offsets (see S3 manifest refs), 2) run connector in soak mode to reproduce fetch timeout, 3) trigger parquet write with corrupted manifest simulation: `aws s3 cp bad_manifest.json s3://.../manifest.json` then run rollup job `python tools/rollup.py --tenant org_8nM4 --hour 2026-03-12T02:00Z`. Expect: rollup abort + partial marker.
marie-support: thanks. I've sent steps and the ticket link to NimblePay with ETA: dataeng will backfill and support will follow up.
raj-dataeng: backfill plan: run safe reingest for 02:00-06:00 UTC windows, validate checksums, then run aggregator with `--force-complete`. Est ETA ~6h depending on queue.
carlos-sre: monitoring alert created for similar manifest checksum failures to catch early (alerts/#manifests).
elaine-support: customer asked if this will affect billing. marie: please escalate billing ops if the backfill doesn't finish by EOD.
marie-support: noted — billing ops looped in. I'll post updates here as backfill progresses. :thumbsup:
ingest-bot: backfill job submitted job_id=bf_20260312_org8nM4_01 status=queued
raj-dataeng: marking for follow-up after job completes. Will post verification query to check counts: `SELECT hour, count(*) FROM usage_events WHERE tenant='org_8nM4' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-03-12 02:00' AND '2026-03-12 06:00' GROUP BY hour;`
marie-support: closing interim with customer (not resolved) — will update when backfill done.
ingest-bot: backfill job update job_id=bf_20260312_org8nM4_01 status=running started_at=1768510800
carlos-sre: job hit a worker OOM at 1768512000, restarted automatically, resumed. Noted memory pressure, increasing worker pool for backfill.
raj-dataeng: backfill finished successfully at 1768513200, verified row counts match expected for all hours.
elaine-support: thanks team — marie can you confirm with NimblePay and close?
marie-support: told customer backfill completed and numbers should be visible in Console within the next 10-15m; asked them to confirm billing queries. They acknowledged.
ingest-bot: backfill job update job_id=bf_20260312_org8nM4_01 status=completed finished_at=1768513200 rows_ingested=13420
marie-support: resolved from support side, adding postmortem notes for dataeng: root cause = transient Kafka fetch timeouts -> parquet manifest checksum mismatch -> partial-rollup skip. Action items: add manifest write retries, S3 eventual consistency guard, increase consumer fetch timeout for high-latency partitions.
raj-dataeng: will open a short RFC for manifest retry + alerting rule.
elaine-support: adding to incident tracker and tagging billing ops for reconciliation.
marie-support: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
